task: Add a deterministic assistant export tool that turns structured tables into downloadable multi-sheet .xlsx (styled/frozen header) or .csv files, reusing the existing file storage and chat download flow.

key_reasoning.reason: The tool-produces-file to sandbox-URL to chat-download chain is fully established and unit-tested by GenerateImageTool (near drop-in template), but the openpyxl workbook construction (bold header Font, freeze_panes, auto-ish column width, multi-sheet) is net-new with zero prior openpyxl usage in src/ to copy.

Roughly 6 files across 2 directories: new export tool + new test module, plus edits to the toolkit (FileSystemToolkit/DataManagementToolkit) get_tools and UI list, tools_vars metadata, pyproject.toml and poetry.lock.

openpyxl must be promoted from transitive/optional to an explicit direct dependency in pyproject.toml (approval-gated per ticket) so it is reliably importable; well-known pure-python library, low conflict risk.
